newsitem.title: USA: Princess Diana arrives in Washington.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana arrives in Washington.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana, newly divorced from heir to the throne Prince Charles, arrived in Washington on Monday ahead of a White House fundraising breakfast for breast cancer research on Tuesday.

Diana arrived at National Airport late on Monday and headed to the Brazilian Embassy, where she will be staying with her friend, Lucia Flecha de Lima, the wife of the Brazilian ambassador to the United States.
She will be first lady Hillary Clinton's guest at the White House breakfast, along with 120 Washington socialites and popular fashion designers.
She is scheduled to attend a lunch at the British embassy and a gala evening on Tuesday night in aid of the Nina Hyde Breast Cancer Fund.

Local television stations reported that Diana flew on the Concorde from London to New York, travelling on to Washington aboard the private jet of Katharine Graham, the retired publisher of the Washington Post newspaper.
